import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static char[] cs;
    static int res = 0;
    static int X = 0;
    static int n;

    static void dfs(int u, int s) {
        if (u >= n) {
            if (s % 25 == 0) res++;
            return;
        }
        int t = cs[u] - '0';
        if (t >= 0 && t <= 9) dfs(u + 1, s * 10 + t);
        else if (cs[u] == 'X') dfs(u + 1, s * 10 + X);
        else {
            if (u == n - 1) {
                dfs(u + 1, s * 10 + 5);
                dfs(u + 1, s * 10);
            } else {
                for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                    if (i == 0 && u == 0) continue;
                    dfs(u + 1, s * 10 + i);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String input = sc.nextLine();
        cs = input.toCharArray();
        n = cs.length;
        boolean hasX = false;
        for (char c : cs) {
            if (c == 'X') {
                hasX = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (cs[0] == '0' && n != 1) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        if (hasX) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                if (cs[0] == 'X' && n > 1 && i == 0) continue;
                X = i;
                dfs(0, 0);
            }
        } else {
            dfs(0, 0);
        }
        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
}

import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static String inputLine;
    static char[] characters;
    static int totalResults = 0;
    static int placeholderX = 0;
    static int length;

    static void explore(int index, int sum) {
        if (index >= length) {
            if (sum % 25 == 0) totalResults++;
            return;
        }
        int digit = characters[index] - '0';
        if (digit >= 0 && digit <= 9) explore(index + 1, sum * 10 + digit);
        else if (characters[index] == 'X') explore(index + 1, sum * 10 + placeholderX);
        else {
            if (index == length - 1) {
                explore(index + 1, sum * 10 + 5);
                explore(index + 1, sum * 10);
            } else {
                for (int i = 1; i < 10; i++) {
                    if (i == 0 && index == 0) continue;
                    explore(index + 1, sum * 10 + i);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void process() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        inputLine = sc.nextLine();
        characters = inputLine.toCharArray();
        length = characters.length;
        boolean containsX = false;
        for (char c : characters) {
            if (c == 'X') {
                containsX = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (characters[0] == '0' && length != 1) {
            System.out.println(0);
            sc.close();
            return;
        }
        if (containsX) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                if (characters[0] == 'X' && length > 1 && i == 0) continue;
                placeholderX = i;
                explore(0, 0);
            }
        } else {
            explore(0, 0);
        }
        System.out.println(totalResults);
        sc.close();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        process();
    }
}
